title: Cross-contract reentrancy via nudge address with hookable rewardToken
justification: CEI violation creates a reentrancy surface conditional on a hookable rewardToken (ERC777, ERC1363) AND attacker-controlled nudge address. Setting rewardToken is owner-controlled and USDC has no hooks, so the path requires explicit owner action to introduce a hookable token. Demoted to Low based on convergent severity-auditor and validity-checker feedback that the PoC demonstrates only ordering (ORDERING_ONLY), not direct value extraction.
preconditions: rewardToken has transfer hooks AND nudge is attacker-controlled.
impact: Nudge transfer fires before phlimbo.collectReward; hook can re-enter or interact with external contracts mid-claim before phlimbo accounting completes.
attack_path_summary: 1) Owner sets hookable rewardToken. 2) Owner sets nudge to attacker-controlled contract. 3) Claim transfers nudgeAmount to attacker, hook fires, attacker calls into other systems before phlimbo.collectReward.
poc_notes: Ordering demo, not a value-extraction PoC. The PoC proves the CEI gap by deploying an ERC1363-style HookableRewardToken whose _update() invokes onTokenReceived on contract recipients. A NudgeReceiver registered as `nudge` records the moment its hook fires using a shared OrderingOracle. The test asserts: (1) the nudge hook fires DURING claim(), (2) hook ordering index < phlimbo.collectReward ordering index in the shared oracle, (3) at hook time the SYA's reward-token balance equals phlimboAmount (not yet forwarded), and (4) at hook time phlimbo.collectRewardCallCount == 0. Direct value extraction is not demonstrated because (a) SYA's nonReentrant guard blocks recursive claim() entry and (b) phlimbo is not itself a victim of this hook in the current architecture. The finding's value is the ordering itself: any external system the nudge contract interacts with during its callback observes SYA in an inconsistent intermediate state. Impact is conditional on the owner setting a hookable reward token (USDC has no hooks). PoC tests: test_M08_NudgeHookFiresBeforePhlimboCollect (PASS) and test_M08_PlainTokenHasNoHook (PASS, sanity).
demotion_note: Demoted from Medium based on ORDERING_ONLY PoC convergent feedback from severity-auditor and validity-checker. Architectural defect documented for protocol hardening but does not demonstrate direct value extraction.
